title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Every payment we process runs on the infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com , the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are building a platform that lets product teams run across multiple clouds and regions. We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager who can turn a complex, multi-team technical programme into a plan people trust and deliver against. This is a senior role in an established, fast-moving team. You will own the multi-cloud and multi-region programme end to end: the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the roadmap. You will bring enough technical depth to work as a peer with our engineers and architects, and pair it with a product mindset: you treat the platform as a product with internal customers, and you judge success by whether those teams adopt it. As a Senior Technical Programme Manager, you are responsible for delivering the programme across teams you don't manage. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure the programme meets the standards a regulated payments business demands. What we are looking for: A track record of delivering large infrastructure or platform programmes: a cloud migration, a new region, a cloud landing zone build, a data centre exit, or similar infrastructure related project within a fast paced technology environment Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers. You won’t need low level knowledge but you should be comfortable discussing networking between clouds and regions, identity and access, infrastructure as code pipelines, and what latency, data residency and failover mean for payments workloads Experience working with cloud providers and partners to align their support and funding with your delivery plan, ideally Azure alongside AWS Product thinking applied to internal platforms: you have treated engineering teams as customers, worked out what they need, and measured whether they adopted it. Clear written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders Proven ability to get commitments from teams and leaders who don't report to you. Experience in a regulated environment, such as financial services or payments How you’ll make an impact: Run the programme end to end, from sequencing the work through to production, across several teams and multiple cloud providers. Own the roadmap. Understand what product engineering teams need before they can deploy into Azure or a new cloud region, help decide which paved roads come first, and set adoption measures we can report on. Turn architecture decisions into delivery plans. Work with our senior engineers and architects on design trade-offs, make sure decisions get written down, and spot when a decision is blocking delivery. Manage dependencies and risk across teams you don't control, and escalate early, with options, when something is going to slip. Build compliance from the start. PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2 apply to most of what this programme touches, and control requirements need to show up in the plan, before any production workloads go live. Keep the delivery records honest. Our roadmap lives in Jira Product Discovery and delivery in Jira; you'll work with the relevant teams to make sure both reflect what is actually happening. Use AI tools in how you run the programme: status reporting, dependency analysis, drafting and keeping documentation current. We use them heavily and expect you to as well. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Generalist
description: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we are making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the London office. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h3> <p>Join Tailscale’s growing Sales team and help existing customers get more value from our product.</p> <p>As a Customer Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for expansion and renewal opportunities across a portfolio of existing customers—from account planning, prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation and close. You will identify new use cases, build relationships with key stakeholders and help customers expand their adoption of Tailscale. This is a quota-carrying closing role for someone with previous full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience. You will partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Marketing and Product to deliver results for customers.</p> <p>We’re a collaborative team with a wide variety of backgrounds. We coach each other, share feedback and support one another in achieving our goals while staying focused on our customers’ needs.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Key Responsibilities</span></h3> <ul> <li>Develop a strong understanding of Tailscale, its use cases and the business value it delivers to customers.</li> <li>Proactively build and qualify expansion pipeline within existing accounts by identifying new teams, stakeholders and use cases.</li> <li>Own and deliver against an expansion and renewal quota across your customer portfolio.</li> <li>Run the full sales cycle: lead discovery, coordinate technical evaluations with Solutions Engineering, communicate value, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms and close agreements.</li> <li>Balance near-term revenue delivery with consistent pipeline generation and timely renewal planning.</li> <li>Maintain accurate opportunity records and provide reliable weekly forecasts, with clear next steps, close plans and visibility into risks.</li> <li>Build mutual action plans with customers and partner with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to support adoption, demonstrate value and drive expansion and renewals.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What We Are Looking For</span></h3> <ul> <li>1+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience.</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of opportunities from prospecting and qualification through discovery, evaluation, negotiation and close.</li> <li>Experience selling developer or technical products, particularly in a product-led growth (PLG) environment.</li> <li>Strong discovery, presentation and relationship-building skills, including experience engaging senior managers and executives.</li> <li>A track record of meeting or exceeding sales quota and the ability to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales cycle.</li> <li>Proven pipeline management and forecasting discipline, with experience using a CRM and tools such as Gong to manage opportunities and collaborate internally.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and Support to deliver positive customer outcomes.</li> <li>A proactive, accountable approach to growing existing customer relationships, with the curiosity and initiative to uncover new opportunities in a high-growth software business.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role is based in London and requires three days per week in the office.</strong></li> </ul> <p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. title: Data Architect
description: <h2>Opportunity</h2> <p>Brunswick is accelerating its use of AI to strengthen the advice we give clients and how we operate. We are looking for a Data Architect to join our AI Lab and shape the technical and data foundations that enable us to build and scale proprietary AI products securely and effectively.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, influential role spanning architecture and practical delivery. You will take a portfolio-wide view of how data, applications, models, APIs and shared components fit together, creating reusable patterns and capabilities that help engineers move faster while maintaining high standards of security, resilience and maintainability.</p> <p>Working closely with AI Engineers, Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams, you will ensure the Lab has the architecture and underlying platform it needs to innovate at pace while aligning with Brunswick’s wider technology environment.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Design and evolve the data and technical architecture underpinning the AI Lab’s portfolio of proprietary products.</li> <li>Define scalable patterns for how applications, data sources, models, APIs and enterprise systems connect and interact.</li> <li>Design approaches to data modelling, access, storage, movement and governance, particularly for sensitive or business-critical information.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to create reusable services, components and data capabilities that accelerate development across multiple products.</li> <li>Establish standards and patterns for data pipelines, APIs, integration, environments, deployment and observability.</li> <li>Work closely with engineers to translate architectural principles into practical solutions, balancing scalability with rapid prototyping and delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Data and other technology teams to ensure solutions meet Brunswick’s security, privacy, governance and architectural standards.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape, reduce duplication and improve interoperability across the firm.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging technologies and architectural approaches that could strengthen the Lab’s platform or unlock new capabilities.</li> <li>Help build the scalable data foundations Brunswick needs to develop and deploy AI responsibly, securely and effectively.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>You will combine strong data and solution architecture skills with a practical engineering mindset and the ability to operate in a fast-moving product environment. You will be comfortable moving between strategic architecture and detailed technical decisions, making pragmatic trade-offs between long-term scalability and speed of delivery. The successful candidate will bring:</p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>6+ years of relevant experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data engineering, software engineering or a related technical role.</li> <li>Strong experience designing scalable data and application architectures, ideally in cloud environments.</li> <li>Experience designing data models, APIs, integrations and data flows across databases, SaaS applications and enterprise systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of modern data architecture, including data modelling, ETL/ELT pipelines, storage, access patterns, data warehouses, lakes/lakehouses and governance.</li> <li>Experience with cloud platforms; Microsoft Azure experience is particularly relevant.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of SQL and modern data engineering approaches, including Python.</li> <li>Experience designing reusable technical components, shared services or platforms used across multiple products or teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of data governance, security, privacy, lineage and quality, and how these are embedded into architecture and delivery.</li> <li>An understanding of the data requirements of AI and machine-learning applications, including securely making structured and unstructured enterprise data available to AI solutions.</li> <li>A good understanding of modern software engineering and SDLC practices, including CI/CD, version control, testing and observability.</li> <li>Sufficient hands-on technical depth to work credibly with engineers, review designs and contribute to implementation where useful.</li> <li>Strong judgement and pragmatism, with the ability to balance consistency and reuse with experimentation and speed.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable experience</p> <ul> <li>Architecting applications or platforms incorporating generative AI, large language models or machine learning.</li> <li>Designing data and integration architectures for AI applications, including retrieval and grounding approaches.</li> <li>Building internal developer platforms, shared services or reusable application frameworks.</li> <li>Working with sensitive enterprise data and complex security or governance requirements.</li> <li>Experience in professional services, financial services, advisory or another complex enterprise environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <p>Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1>About Brunswick</h1> <p>Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes. </p> <p>Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.</p> <p>Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world. </p> <p> </p> <p><em>Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our <a href="https://www.brunswickgroup.com/app/uploads/Group-Privacy-Notice-for-Employees_April-2026.pdf" target="_blank">Global Privacy Notice</a> to understand how your data is managed.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand. We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution. Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals. Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics. Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance. What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation. Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions. Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority. Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy. Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact. Nice to Have Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments. Background working across international or multi-market structures. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders. 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility. 🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves. 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best. We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . title: Enterprise Account Executive
description: SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling. As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities. This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow "AI seller" title. Role and Responsibilities Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition. Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity. Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer. Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders. Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome. Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close. Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload. Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance. Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses. Travel within the assigned territory as required. Required Skills and Experience 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus. Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline. Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners. Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases. Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software. Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills. Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences. Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills. B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field. Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred. title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations. We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe. We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you. The Role We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts. Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability. The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment. Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them. Key Responsibilities Frontend Engineering Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications. Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis. Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows. Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered. Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features. Review and improve our development workflows, continuous integration checks, deployment pipelines and infrastructure. Keep up to date with technology and bring in new standards and practices for improved user or developer experience Performance, Quality, and Reliability Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems. Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently. Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show. Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge. Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF. Agentic and Spec-Driven Development Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations. Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery. Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints. Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture. Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation. Collaboration and Craft Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts. Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming. Define and communicate frontend standards and best practices, and hold the team to them in review. Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover. Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change. Requirements Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale. Sound grasp of UI, UX and accessibility considerations, with the judgement to improve a design before building it rather than implement it exactly as drawn. Demonstrable experience diagnosing and fixing page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems. Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, or New Relic, and of CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD. Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, New Relic or other tools used to monitor, diagnose and fix issues Hands-on background with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions or ArgoCD) as well as modern frontend architecture patterns. Practical awareness of common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF, and how to design against them. Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review. Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English. High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.Experience and Qualifications 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years of commercial React and TypeScript. Experience shipping and operating production frontends for customer-facing SaaS products, including monitoring, incident response, and performance improvement. Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase where design patterns, testability, and maintainability genuinely matter. Experience consuming and shaping REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, ideally backed by Django REST Framework or an equivalent. Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers and designers on shared customer outcomes, not only technical delivery. Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework. Benefits We offer: A salary package aligned to the role and market 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services Enhanced parental leave Life insurance at 4× salary Employee assistance programme Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme Learning management system powered by Udemy Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes Pension scheme Company-sponsored dinners and social gatherings Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
description: Finance Deserves Better Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled. Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one: Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one. Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting. Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter. Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors. The Role We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there. Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors. You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product. What You’ll Be Doing Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break. Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later. Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO. Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language. Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands. Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests. Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline. Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page. What We Think* You’ll Need Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption. A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning. Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more. Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share. Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal. An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why. Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you. A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please. *If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person. The Good Stuff 🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London. 💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options. 🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays. 🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence! 🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever energy and defence customers, partners and industry events take us. 🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in two sectors from their first deals. Light is an equal opportunity employer. The Famous Last Words Energy and defence businesses manage complex projects, contracts and entities on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn both sectors inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Implementation Manager (Italian Speaking)
description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role We're hiring a Founding Implementation Manager to lead how Sona implements in Italy. You'll be the first person doing this job in the market, and you'll own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live. In the UK, our implementations follow an established playbook. In Italy there isn't one yet, so working out how we do this well is part of the job. Expect a lot of unknowns and plans that change. You'll build a clear picture of the lay of the land, take the route that gets us there fastest and bring in the right people from Product, Commercial, our customers and local specialists when they're needed. Day to day, that means keeping a lot of moving parts pointed in the same direction, with stakeholders across our customers, Product and the wider Sona team, and relationships that are rarely simple. You'll own the relationships with our first Italian customers, and build a network of local labour specialists, consultancy-based, whilst you deliver those first implementations. This role isn't for everyone. If you want a defined process and clear direction on what to do next, you'll find it frustrating. If you love ambiguity and changes of plan, take ownership of every implementation and make the next one better than the last, you'll shape how Sona implements in Italy from the start. Responsibilities Work out how Sona implements in Italy, and capture what you learn so each implementation starts from a better place than the last. Own every Italian implementation from kick-off to go-live, adapting the plan as things change. Build and manage relationships with stakeholders across our customers, Product and internal teams, keeping many workstreams moving at once. Own the relationships with our first Italian customers. Build a network of local labour specialists in Italy, consultancy-based, whilst delivering implementations. Bring in the right people at the right moment, and make calls without waiting to be told what to do. Manage risks, dependencies and scope, and communicate changes clearly to everyone affected. Keep finding better ways to implement, and put them into practice on the next project. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker with fluent English. You've delivered complex enterprise software implementations, and you can do it without a playbook handed to you. You love ambiguity and changes of plan, and you stay clear-headed when many things are moving at the same time. You're relentless about finding the fastest route to the outcome, and you work out quickly who needs to be involved. You navigate complex stakeholder relationships well, across customers, Product and internal teams, including at C-level. You have a founder's mentality. You take ownership of the whole outcome, and you keep looking for ways to do it better. Bonus: experience setting up delivery in a new market, product or growing team. Bonus: other European languages, or existing relationships with labour or employment specialists in Italy. title: Global Head of Customer Success
description: About SINGU At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business. title: Account Executive
description: At Nomios, our mission is to build a secure and connected future. We work with organisations across the UK and Europe to protect and connect their digital environments, bringing together leading cybersecurity and networking technologies with specialist expertise and managed services. As we continue to grow our UK business, we’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our Sales team and develop new Commercial and Enterprise customer relationships. This is a new business-focused position for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening new conversations and turning prospects into long-term customers. You’ll be responsible for creating and developing your own pipeline, while also making effective use of the support available through our Business Development, Marketing, Solutions and strategic vendor teams. You’ll take ownership of opportunities throughout the sales journey, from initial prospecting and customer engagement through discovery, solution development, proposal and commercial negotiation to successful close. We’re looking for someone who understands how to maintain momentum throughout a complex sales cycle and is confident taking responsibility for progressing their own deals. Success in this role will also come from being highly visible in the market. You’ll spend time each week engaging directly with customers, prospects and our technology partners, developing relationships, uncovering new opportunities and building a strong network within the cybersecurity and networking community. Cybersecurity sales experience is an important requirement for this position. You’ll need the industry knowledge and commercial credibility to understand customers' security and networking challenges and work with our technical specialists to turn those challenges into valuable solutions. Your role as an Account Executive As an Account Executive at Nomios, you’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and contributing directly to our continued growth across Commercial and Enterprise accounts. You’ll have the autonomy to develop your territory and target accounts, supported by an established team around you, but we are looking for someone who is proactive and takes ownership of generating and progressing their own opportunities. Your responsibilities will include: Creating and developing your own new business pipeline across targeted Commercial and Enterprise organisations Identifying target accounts, researching potential opportunities and confidently establishing new relationships with prospective customers Driving new logo acquisition and converting prospective organisations into long-term Nomios customers Managing opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from first engagement and qualification through to discovery, proposal, negotiation and close Taking ownership of deal progression, maintaining momentum and ensuring clear next steps throughout the sales process Building a strong, qualified pipeline and maintaining accurate and realistic sales forecasts Working closely with our Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify priority accounts, coordinate outbound activity and maximise new business opportunities Developing strong relationships with our strategic technology partners and identifying opportunities to collaborate on target and whitespace accounts Building regular face-to-face engagement with customers, prospective customers and vendors, with an expectation that you will be active in the market each week Understanding customers' cybersecurity, networking and broader business priorities and identifying where Nomios can make a measurable difference Partnering with our Solutions specialists to shape and position appropriate cybersecurity, networking and managed services propositions Coordinating internal expertise across Solutions, Managed Services, Operations, Business Development and leadership to support opportunities Developing persuasive commercial propositions and articulating the value of working with Nomios Building relationships across customer organisations, engaging confidently with technical stakeholders, security and networking teams, procurement and senior/C-level decision-makers Identifying opportunities to broaden the relationship and introduce additional Nomios solutions and services as accounts develop We’re looking for someone who combines strong cybersecurity sales experience with a genuine new business mindset. You’ll be comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for them to come to you, with the commercial skills and resilience needed to progress complex sales conversations through to close. You should have: Proven sales experience within cybersecurity, networking, managed security services or a closely related technology environment A successful track record of developing new Commercial and/or Enterprise customers Demonstrable experience of self-generating opportunities and building pipeline, alongside opportunities generated through BDR, Marketing or vendor activity Experience of taking ownership of opportunities and successfully progressing and closing complex technology deals Expertise in security and networking solutions, ideally with experience working with two or more of the following vendors: Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Rapid7, Netskope, SentinelOne, Wiz or Abnormal Experience collaborating effectively with BDRs, including developing target-account activity and converting prospecting activity into qualified opportunities Experience developing productive relationships with technology vendors, using those partnerships to identify and create new business opportunities A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to take ownership of your market and pipeline Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building capabilities The willingness and confidence to regularly get out into the market and meet customers, prospects and vendor partners The ability to communicate credibly with stakeholders ranging from technical specialists and security architects through to senior executives and C-level decision-makers A consultative approach to selling, with the ability to identify customer challenges and bring together the right people and solutions to address them Strong commercial judgment and confidence negotiating and closing business Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills Strong pipeline management and forecasting disciplines Job Specifics Location : This is a hybrid role, requiring attendance at our Basingstoke office (free hot & cold drinks, breakfast items, snacks, lunches, and regular takeaway Fridays are provided to all staff in the office!) Hours : Full-time, Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm Travel : The role includes travel within the UK, with some overnight stays, and occasional international trips if required Requirements : You will be required to attend customer sites across the UK and must therefore have a full UK driving licence Why would you choose to come and work with us? We invest in our people. You will get to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where you are free to use your initiative in support of our strategic objectives. You will work alongside high calibre sales, technical, and operational experts as part of a supportive, tight-knit team, within which every individual has an important part to play and makes a real difference. Nomios offers a highly competitive salary and commission scheme along with industry-leading benefits. Ready to make an impact? Apply now! title: Technical Account Manager - Data.One
description: <p><strong>Technical Account Manager - Data.One</strong></p> <p>This Technical Account Manager (TAM) role is part of the DataOne business within the ClearScore Group. The TAM demonstrates a balance of deep technical understanding and ability along with outstanding customer service and account management skills. This individual would have responsibility over the full partner lifecycle from onboarding, launch and ongoing maintenance.</p> <p>The TAM role will work closely with the rest of the DataOne business which includes Product, Engineers, Analytics and Commercial counterparts in order to deliver the best experience to our partners.</p> <p>The TAM’s main focusses will be setting up new Partners to start using DataOne open banking data, being on hand to assist partners with changes, and help drive the performance of their open banking usage.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>The main point of contact for our partner relationships after contracts are signed; working closely with our Commercial team to understand needs and goals of Partners.</li> <li>Understand the Partners business objective and be able to be proactive in our approach to establish and maintain excellent partner relationships.</li> <li>Attend and support our Commercial team in partner calls</li> <li>Assist in researching trends and insights around delivering best in class partner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Integration SME</strong></p> <ul> <li>Onboard partners through the integration process, you will be the SME for each individual integration that they own and represent the voice of partners.</li> <li>Ensure that partners stay within the defined strategy of the DataOne team. When a partner is identified for bespoke integration, work with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, and other identified teams to work through solutions for implementing the bespoke work.</li> <li>Take a data-driven approach to provide key partner insights about the integrations, and use these insights to improve our integration experience.</li> <li>Coordinate and manage Partner onboarding plans with our Commercial and Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage all partner requests related to their usage of DataOne’s open banking services. Not only will you manage and process these changes, but you’ll also recommend improvements to ensure high Partner performance.</li> <li>Develop a working knowledge of the ClearScore marketplace landscape and share that knowledge with the wider DataOne team</li> <li>Create custom reports for Partners as and when requested.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Liaise with DataOne engineers to manage backlog of requests.</li> <li>Develop and document processes and procedures to drive efficiencies</li> <li>Collaborate with the DataOne teams to improve functionality to drive down BAU work and drive productivity of our Engineering teams.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a background in Technical Product Ownership, Engineering, or another technical role with direct relationships with clients or partners.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills we'd love you to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A natural planner - ability to coordinate and lead internal and external teams to deliver strong integration performance</li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven - excited by and proficient at using data to make informed decisons</li> <li>Confident working alongside and influencing senior stakeholders</li> <li>Strong writing, communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Organised, proactive, and great attention to detail</li> <li>Positive attitude, able to work under pressure and within a moving framework</li> </ul> <p></p> <p> </p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Why ClearScore?</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds.</p> <p>We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.</p> <p>Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">What is D·One?</strong></p> <p>D·One was created in 2022 as a result of ClearScore’s acquisition of Money Dashboard - a company with best in class open banking and categorisation capabilities. The D·One mission exists to provide open banking data to lending partners, market researchers including hedge funds and ClearScore. Currently, our primary goal is enabling lenders to adopt open banking by delivering a lender specific open banking service with best-in-class credit analytics.</p> <p>As part of the ClearScore Group, you will join a company where our culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.</p> <p>If you feel like this could be the place for you, apply and our Talent team will be happy to share more.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 paid holidays and a “duvet day” on your birthday</li> <li>Hybrid Work Environment</li> <li>Private health and dental cover - including mental health support through Bupa </li> <li>GP office visits</li> <li>Life assurance scheme</li> <li>Up to 6% matched pension</li> <li>Regular Lunch and Learns with guest speakers</li> <li>Dog-friendly office</li> <li>Daily breakfast and free snacks</li> <li>Access to discounts via Cobens Extras </li> <li>Free sports and social clubs</li> <li>Continued investment into learning and development </li> <li>Leadership-led training</li> <li>In-house psychotherapist</li> <li>Financial coach to help you plan and achieve your goals</li> <li>No clock-watching culture</li> <li>Generous maternity and paternity plans</li> <li>Culture and inclusion representatives</li> <li>Transparent pay structure and a career growth plan</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.</p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Our Hybrid Model</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> </div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We embrace a dynamic hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with collaborative in-person experiences. Our approach is designed to foster innovation, team connection, and individual productivity.</div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Levels 1-5: Minimum 2 days per week in-office</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><strong>What This Means for You:</strong></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Flexibility to manage your work and life</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"> Office facilities (with plants!) designed for productive interactions</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Clear expectations and support for maintaining our hybrid schedule</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">Note: While we offer flexibility, commitment to our hybrid schedule is an important aspect of our team culture and performance expectations.</em></div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong data-redactor-tag="strong">Inclusion Policy</strong></p> <p>We are always looking for talented individuals to join ClearScore. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our people. Please see our People Policy Notice at <a href="https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice">https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3 id="isPasted"><strong>Company Overview</strong></h3> <p>Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.</p> <p>Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.</p> <p>At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.</p> <p>Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.</p></div><h3><strong>Position Summary</strong></h3> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"aaed607e-c2a3-5841-9fb4-41037bfa0faf|1","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[201342446,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"3",201342449,"1",469777841,"Times New Roman",469777842,"Times New Roman",469777843,"Times New Roman",469777844,"Times New Roman",201341986,"1",469769226,"Times New Roman",268442635,"24",469775450,"paragraph",201340122,"2",134233614,"true",469778129,"paragraph",335572020,"1",134233118,"true",134233117,"true",469778324,"Normal"]}">Reporting to </span><span class="NormalTextRun SpellingErrorV2Themed SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">Metrea’s</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> Procurement Manager, th</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph">is role</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> will</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> primarily</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW120639824 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="paragraph"> execute and manage end-to-end procurement activities across the UK and EU operations. title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundations
description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role LemFi's Foundations tribe is the platform backbone every product team relies on. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do. What you'll build and own Own and evolve our core identity and onboarding services - KYC flows, verification orchestration and the data contracts that downstream systems depend on. Build and maintain internal SDKs and shared libraries that abstract platform concerns (auth, identity, caching, eventing) so product teams can move without friction. Define and champion cross-platform architectural standards, making opinionated decisions about service design, API contracts and data consistency that the wider engineering org follows. Drive engagement platform capabilities - rewards logic, CRM integrations and Lemfi cash - from spec to production, using AI-assisted development tooling to compress iteration cycles without sacrificing correctness. Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services. Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions. Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras. Your experience At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort. Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person. Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project. Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you. Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for. Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend. Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role. Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information. Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work. We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible. Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools. The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks.
