We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role The Special Operations Agent plays a vital back-office role, managing Lendable’s correspondence and administration with the third parties involved in our customers’ accounts. These include debt management companies, insolvency practitioners, credit reference agencies, debt purchasers and incoming post, across our UK Unsecured Loans, UK Credit Cards and UK Motor Finance products. You will follow detailed procedures to process a high volume of third-party requests accurately and efficiently. By taking ownership of every task and request from third parties, from receipt to final resolution, through portals, spreadsheets, email and post, you will make sure that customers in debt solutions or Breathing Space are protected, credit files are accurate, and Lendable meets its legal and regulatory obligations. You will also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and processes. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves, with a focus on keeping clear and complete records for audit and adhering to compliance standards. Key Responsibilities Process Debt Management Plan (DMP) proposals, balance requests and terminations from debt management companies via portals, spreadsheets and bulk upload tools Administer insolvency cases, including IVAs, Trust Deeds, bankruptcies, Debt Relief Orders and Scotland’s Debt Arrangement Scheme, including proofs of debt and write-offs Apply Breathing Space protections to accounts and manage each case through to expiry or cancellation Investigate credit file disputes from the credit reference agencies and submit weekly amendments Respond to queries from purchasers of sold debt, including putbacks, buybacks, disputes and document requests, and send them balance adjustments Sort, process and route incoming post, including verifying a third party’s authority to act, handling cheques and escalating urgent or regulatory correspondence Process deceased account notifications and debt consolidation balance requests Record vulnerability disclosures before taking any other action on an account Support frontline colleagues by answering their credit file and third-party queries Meet all deadlines and keep accurate records and a full audit trail of every action and decision Handle sensitive data securely and escalate risks, errors and anything outside the procedure promptly Identify process gaps and give feedback to improve our procedures and automation Complete training and keep up to date with changes to systems, products and procedures Person Specification Experience & Skills Experience in a back-office, operations, collections, credit reporting or financial services administration environment Excellent attention to detail, with a disciplined approach to checking your own work Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel or Google Sheets), including working with CSV files, data matching and reconciling figures Confident following detailed, step-by-step procedures while applying judgement when a case doesn’t fit Clear, professional written communication, as most contact is by email Able to manage multiple queues and deadlines in a fast-paced setting and to prioritise accurately Comfortable using multiple portals and internal systems, and adopting new tools, including automation and AI-assisted processes Behaviours & Approach Methodical and diligent, with a high level of personal accountability for accuracy and outcomes Calm and composed under deadline pressure Willing to ask questions, challenge and escalate when something doesn’t look right Resilient, adaptable and open to constant change and learning Collaborative and supportive of colleagues, committed to shared success Constructive and solutions-focused, with a willingness to challenge the status quo Desirable Knowledge of UK debt solutions (DMPs, IVAs, DROs, Breathing Space) and credit file reporting Understanding of vulnerable customer considerations, Consumer Duty and data protection Experience working with debt management companies, insolvency practitioners or credit reference agencies Knowledge of AI tools and automation, and an interest in using them to improve how work gets done The interview process We’re not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we’d expect: 1) A 15 minute Cognitive Assessment 2) A 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team 3) An onsite Interview and Assessment with the Special Operations Team Leader Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner. Check out our blog ! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Fire Engineer
description: <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Principal Fire Engineer to join our growing team in Birmingham. This is a technical leadership role offering the opportunity to deliver complex fire engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial, and infrastructure developments.</p> <p>As a Principal Fire Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping fire safety strategies, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting business growth through strong client relationships and technical innovation. You will not only lead on some of the industry’s most exciting projects but also have a key role in shaping the future talent within our teams through mentorship and development opportunities.</p> <p><strong>Why join us to grow your career?</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Denmark, Italy, and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.</li> <li>As a Principal Engineer you will be an integral part of a dynamic technical team, working with other experienced Engineers, Surveyors and teams including our Forensics division. You will work on the industry's leading technical projects.</li> <li>Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team that always strives to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.</li> <li>You will be given early the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to achieve chartered status and offer help and support during the process</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and deliver complex fire engineering projects from inception through to completion.</li> <li>Develop fire strategies for a wide range of new-build and existing building projects.</li> <li>Undertake fire safety engineering analyses, including evacuation modelling, smoke control assessments, and performance-based design solutions.</li> <li>Provide expert advice on compliance with UK Building Regulations, Approved Document B, and relevant fire safety legislation.</li> <li>Review and approve technical reports, calculations, and design documentation.</li> <li>Liaise with architects, developers, contractors, approval authorities, and wider project teams.</li> <li>Act as a technical lead and mentor for junior and mid-level engineers.</li> <li>Contribute to business development activities, including client engagement, tender submissions, and project proposals.</li> <li>Maintain awareness of evolving legislation, industry standards, and best practices.</li> <li>Represent the business at client meetings, industry events, and technical forums.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree qualified in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.</li> <li>Ideally be or working towards becoming a Chartered Engineer.</li> <li>A background in fire engineering preferably within a consultancy environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and annual bonus scheme.</li> <li>Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.</li> <li>Private healthcare.</li> <li>Generous pension contribution.</li> <li>Life assurance and income protection.</li> <li>Professional membership subscriptions.</li> <li>Ongoing training and support towards professional development.</li> <li>Clear career progression pathways.</li> <li>A collaborative and inclusive working environment where technical excellence is valued and rewarded.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">#LI-SG1</span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p> </p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.  Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.  Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p> </p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Consultant, AI Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses.</p> <p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>MAP is part of<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/wpp.com/__;!!IfJP2Nwhk5Z0yJ43lA!L_cfT4E3gsmmDY1lVQTB6ihlfPeBl9X4sMM2KI6iWZYexC2nCeZ9oxgP9qvgbrqxIBpx82rGb_mWqh5F0zKxq5_dP7Y$" data-outlook-id="5677231c-455b-4705-9250-42d6515234fb">WPP</a>, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p></div><p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We are 12,000 experts across 40+ markets, partnering with the platforms our clients run on: Adobe, AWS, Salesforce and the frontier AI labs. </p> <p>Most of our clients have already invested in agentic AI tooling but have yet to see the promised value gain. We’re helping clients close that gap and realize the value of their AI stack. We are looking for an Associate Consultant to join our AI Transformation work: helping marketing, CRM and content teams find the use cases that matter, build solutions with the tools they own, and move from testing AI to scaling their work with it. You will contribute to the same journey across our global client portfolio and inside MAP, where we treat ourselves as client number one.  </p> <h2>What will your day look like?</h2> <p>In this role, you will build, measure and drive adoption of frontier AI for marketing teams at the world’s biggest brands and for MAP itself. You will sit with teams such as CRM, campaign and content to understand how their work really gets done, then build the skills, MCPs or agents that help them reach their goals. You will be at the frontier of re-designing work to fit the agentic era: you will help showcase where and how AI has an impact on time and quality and where we still need human judgement in the workflows of tomorrow. Your work will make a real difference to people's working lives, giving them time back to focus on more ambitious and creative work. You will be working in tandem with senior profiles from the team who will mentor you and hand you more ownership as you grow. </p> <ul> <li><strong>Use-case & workflow discovery</strong> – Sit alongside the people who do the work, in client teams and across MAP, such as campaign managers, CRM specialists and content producers, and learn their role in the marketing lifecycle. Help them redesign workflows with state-of-the-art tools and spot where AI could change the cost or speed of a deliverable, while capturing it in use-case templates and a prioritised backlog, and contribute to AI maturity assessments. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Build with teams</strong> – Recommend and build the skills, MCPs, agents and integrations that redesign how a team works, using frontier models, and test them with real users until the new workflow is theirs. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Measure impact</strong> – You will build simple value models for the identified use-cases and shape the success criteria with the team as the work evolves.<u> </u> </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Demos for pitches</strong> – Create quick, tailored demos showing how AI can address client challenges, and help present them in pitches and client discussions. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive adoption</strong> – Help client and MAP teams upskill with AI: run knowledge-sharing sessions and office hours, write the playbooks teams use after you leave, support champion networks, and keep an adoption scorecard that shows leadership what is working. </li> </ul> <h2>Who are you going to work with?</h2> <p>You will join the AI Solutions Consulting team at MAP, and work alongside our team of AI engineers. Day to day you will work with senior AI consultants and with colleagues across WPP Enterprise Solutions, from experience strategy to client engagement. Your clients will include some of the world's biggest brands in industries such as FMCG, automotive, energy, food service and retail. </p> <h2>What do you bring to the table?</h2> <p>We hire for a mindset, not a background. Demoing work you have built matters more than where you built it. </p> <p><strong>What you must have </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A relevant degree or early experience.</strong> You have completed a degree in a relevant field such as digital innovation, strategy and technology, management, business analytics, philosophy, design or computer science, or up to 2 years' experience in consulting, marketing operations, CRM or a related role.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You are AI-native.</strong> You work with the agent in the middle, and you regularly build things with LLM’s: a workflow you automated, a skill others use, a tool you wired together. We will ask you to walk us through something you built, how and why, not just the output.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You are fascinated by brands and the art of persuasion.</strong> You want to understand how AI can transform and broaden the traditional marketing lifecycle, and you use what you know to improve how teams work, earning their trust as someone who makes their job better.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You think like an experimenter.</strong> You test and learn: set a baseline, measure what changed and decide what to do next, with the curiosity and discipline to grow and scale what works.<br><br></li> <li><strong>A proactive and organized way of working.</strong> You take a brief and come back with something real, you unblock yourself, and you keep several client threads moving at once without dropping one.<br><br></li> <li><strong>You explain AI clearly.</strong> You can make AI make sense to people who don't work with it every day, in writing and in the room. </li> </ul> <p><strong>What sets you apart </strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in a marketing, CRM, customer experience or martech team, including familiarity with Adobe, Salesforce or Braze. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have designed or run at least one workshop or training session for non-technical teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>You have been part of at least one change-management, adoption or AI transformation programme, in any setting. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience building with AI engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor – we do not expect you to be a software engineer. </li> </ul> <p>You are welcome to use AI to help with your application. Just tell us how you used it. </p> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p></p> <p>MAP is a world-leading Centre of Excellence that helps businesses humanize the relationship between the brand and the customer through hyper personalization at scale, marketing automation and CRM. With the brain of a consultancy, the heart of an agency and the power of technology and data, we work with some of the world's most admired brands to help them on their transformation journey to becoming truly customer-centric. Together, we are 1000 + technology specialists, data scientists, strategic thinkers, consultants, operations experts, and creative minds from 55+ nationalities.</p> <p>#LI-NAMER</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (MAP/VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</span></span><span class="scxw176048299"><span lang="EN-GB"> </span></span></p> <p>When you click “Apply now” below, your information is sent to MAP/VML. These capabilities support our internal product teams and deliver data to clients—either in client-owned cloud environments or in our own.</p> <p>The role is GCP-first, with security patterns that can be applied across AWS and Azure. You’ll help build the controls that make these services safe to use, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring and protection against risks such as prompt injection, tool misuse and data leakage.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Security Operations, Privacy, Legal, Marketing and Client Delivery teams. gateways and registries with approved-tool allowlisting, tool-level authorisation, rate limits and auditable records of tool calls.</li> <li>Implement OAuth 2.1/OIDC authorisation using short-lived, exfiltration through chained tool calls.</li> <li>Help secure the agent and connector supply chain through vetting, signing, versioning, scanning and sandboxing.</li> </ul> <h3>Engineer identity and access controls</h3> <ul> <li>Implement identity patterns for people, workloads and agents across Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including federation, SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access and phishing-resistant MFA.</li> <li>Extend identity governance to service accounts, API keys, workload identities and AI agents, using Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform.</li> data-sharing patterns, including data clean rooms and consent-aware pipelines.</li> <li>Help prevent sensitive data from leaking into agent prompts, context windows, logs or third-party models, and access to private data, untrusted content and the ability to publish externally without appropriate safeguards.</li> <li>Work with Marketing and Communications teams to detect and respond to account takeovers, impersonation and advertising-account fraud.</li> </ul> <h3>Improve detection, response and secure delivery</h3> <ul> <li>Send cloud, identity, MCP, model-safety and social-platform logs to actions.</li> <li>Create golden paths, reference implementations and runbooks that help delivery teams build securely and independently.</li> <li>Contribute to threat-modelling sessions, red-team exercises, design reviews and audit-readiness activities.</li> <li>Help map controls to relevant standards and automate evidence collection.</li> <li>Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <h3>Experience and technical skills</h3> <ul> <li>Seasoned<strong> experience</strong> in cloud infrastructure, platform, data or security engineering, title: Manager, Analytics, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Today, as part of Amazon, it combines Hollywood legacy with the scale, innovation and customer obsession of one of the world's most influential entertainment companies.</p> <p>MGM's future slate reflects this unique position, bringing audiences a diverse portfolio of theatrical releases and cultural moments. Upcoming titles such as Verity, The Thomas Crown Affair, The Sheep Detective, Masters of the Universe, and The Beekeeper 2 show the breadth of MGM's ambitions across adaptations, franchises, action blockbusters and original storytelling.</p> <p>OpenDoor was built to help MGM maximise the impact of these moments. By combining WPP's talent, capabilities and technology, we create integrated solutions that connect media, creative, data, strategy, commerce and measurement into a seamless operating model. Our role extends beyond campaign execution to helping MGM understand audiences, optimise investment, measure business impact and build long-term cultural relevance.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next-level productivity through our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms and Process. Drawing expertise from across WPP agencies and disciplines, our teams work closely with MGM stakeholders to unlock smarter, faster and more effective ways of bringing stories to audiences worldwide.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you become part of a team operating at the intersection of entertainment, technology, media and creativity. You'll work alongside leading industry talent while supporting one of the world's most exciting film studios as it enters its next chapter, helping shape how audiences discover and engage with stories that define culture.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>We are searching for an analytically ambitious, detail-oriented analytics specialist with a genuine passion for film and entertainment to join our OpenDoor team as Manager, Trailer & Campaign Analytics – MGM. This role reports into the Global Director of Insights for MGM and is based in London.</p> <p>This is a high-impact individual contributor role focused on building and scaling the analytics infrastructure for trailer performance and in-flight campaign measurement across MGM's theatrical release slate and global marketing operations. You will own the end-to-end setup and delivery of automated trailer reporting systems, working with the team to establish benchmarks, build learnings, and continuously optimize campaign performance through data-driven insights.</p> <p>What makes this role distinctive is the opportunity to build measurement discipline from the ground up for two critical areas: pre-launch trailer analytics and real-time in-flight campaign monitoring. You'll inherit foundational frameworks and collaborate with the broader Measurement team to enhance these with attention measurement, creative A/B testing, and social listening capabilities. You're expected to identify opportunities for automation and agent-assisted reporting that will scale insights over time — contributing directly to the efficiency and impact of MGM's global theatrical marketing operation.</p> <p>This role operates at the intersection of Paid Media measurement, Cultural Impact analytics, Creative Performance, and multi-platform reporting — translating performance data into clear, actionable insights that directly inform investment and optimization decisions across MGM's theatrical release calendar. The scope is global with particular focus on key markets, informing measurement practice and learning agendas that shape how MGM launches its most ambitious stories.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p>Establish & Run Trailer Analytics Reporting</p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operationalize automated trailer performance reporting across all format variants (teaser, full trailer, format cuts) and distribution platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc.)</li> <li>Establish standardized reporting cadence: 24-hour, 72-hour, and 7-day performance snapshots for all trailer launches across key territories and global markets</li> <li>Define and build trailer-level KPI frameworks (view velocity, engagement rates, audience retention, CPA, brand lift signals) and communicate performance against pre-established benchmarks</li> <li>Integrate territory-level performance data to identify which markets are responding strongest to creative approaches, messaging, and format variants</li> <li>Support the development of automated reporting pipelines and dashboards that enable stakeholders to self-serve key insights between formal reports</li> </ul> <p>Integrate Social Listening & Cultural Impact Measurement</p> <ul> <li>Deploy social listening tools (Brandwatch, Talkwalker, or equivalent) to track organic conversation, sentiment, and cultural momentum around trailer launches</li> <li>Combine organic social signals with paid media performance to build a holistic view of trailer impact across both channels</li> <li>Identify emerging cultural moments, audience conversations, and competitive dynamics that materially affect trailer performance and audience receptivity</li> <li>Generate weekly cultural impact summaries that accompany trailer performance data, providing context beyond metrics</li> <li>Use these insights to advise creative and media teams on what's resonating, what's falling flat, and where optimization is needed pre-launch and in real-time</li> </ul> <p>Support Attention Measurement & Creative Testing</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with the Measurement team to integrate attention metrics (eye-tracking, dwell time, brand recall diagnostics) into in-flight campaign analysis</li> <li>Work with media planning and creative teams to design and interpret A/B tests on creative variants, messaging approaches, and media placements</li> <li>Translate attention and creative testing outputs into clear performance narratives that inform mid-campaign optimization and creative recommendations for future campaigns</li> </ul> <p>Benchmark Performance & Inform Strategic Planning</p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain a comparative benchmarking framework for trailer and campaign performance, comparing each title against historical performance, competitive context, and similar content archetypes</li> <li>Produce quarterly comparative analysis documenting how each title is tracking vs. benchmark, highlighting where performance is tracking ahead/behind and why</li> <li>Generate longitudinal learning summaries that synthesize insights across multiple title campaigns, identifying patterns in what drives trailer and campaign effectiveness</li> <li>Work closely with the Global Director of Analytics to translate findings into broader patterns and insights that inform MGM's next-generation campaign planning</li> <li>Advise on investment decisions for upcoming titles based on similar historical performance and learnings from comparable campaigns</li> </ul> <p>Build Analytics Infrastructure & Automation Opportunities</p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to automate routine reporting, data integration, and insight generation — reducing manual effort and accelerating insight delivery</li> <li>Document data sources, methodologies, and reporting logic to create reusable frameworks for future title campaigns</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader OpenDoor technology and analytics teams to explore agent-assisted or AI-enhanced reporting approaches that could scale insights over time</li> </ul> <p>Partner Across Functions</p> <ul> <li>Work hand-in-hand with Media Planning, Paid Social, and Creative teams to ensure measurement insights directly inform campaign strategy and optimization</li> <li>Provide clear, accessible reporting that We’re on a mission to transform marketing by leveraging the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.  </p> <p>Our team works with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through analytically minded people leveraging AI and tech to drive real business change for our clients. We’re endlessly curious. Our team of analytical thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world. Within our UK Data, Tech and Analytics team we host three core practices – Modelling Services, Applied Analytics and Data Science and Solutions. </p> <p>The Data Science & Solutions practice is the innovation engine and technical accelerator for WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics Division in the UK. We bridge advanced data science, artificial intelligence, and software engineering to solve high-value client challenges and supercharge agency capabilities. The practice operates at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial media application—incubating proprietary analytical tools, advancing AI adoption, and delivering specialised machine learning models that go beyond traditional econometrics. We strive to be the benchmark for intelligent, ethical and commercially transformative decisioning through applied data science.</p> <p><strong>Team Summary and Remit</strong> </p> <p>Sitting alongside Modelling Services and Applied Analytics within our 120-strong UK Analytics organisation, the Data Science & Solutions team has two core mandates: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Tool & Solution Development:</strong> Designing, engineering, and productising bespoke analytical applications, automation pipelines, and AI-enabled tools that elevate the speed, sophistication, and efficiency of our wider Modelling and Applied Analytics teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong><em>Specialised Modelling & Advanced Analytics (Role Focus):</em></strong><em> Delivering high-impact data science assignments requiring techniques beyond the core scope of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), such as customer lifetime value (CLV), propensity and churn modelling, advanced incrementality algorithms, and price elasticity.</em> </li> </ul> <p>This Director role will focus on the second of the two above – Specialised Modelling and Advanced Analytics, helping to enhance the implementation of our internal solutions related to this. Our other director's remit sits in the first area of mandates. There is of course collaboration – but we are looking for someone to bring expertise in the second mandate of the team. </p> <p>These mandates are delivered in line with our principles – <strong>Value, Scale and Innovation</strong>. Turning complex data signals into undeniable business growth for our clients. Being trusted co-pilots who make solutions scalable, interpretable and actionable. Working in a high trust, high impact environment where innovation yields measurable consequence. </p> <p><strong>Summary of Role Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p>As Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK, your core mandate is to <strong>Execute Strategy at Scale - specifically driving our implementation of Advanced Analytics Data Science solutions across the UK</strong>. You will translate practice strategy set by the VP and functional leadership into measurable operational outcomes and delivery excellence across significant client portfolios. You are accountable for overseeing programme delivery, driving operational optimisation, and managing team structures that deliver robust, production-grade analytics. </p> <p>Strategic Execution & Technical Leadership </p> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Planning: </strong>Translate practice strategy and data science roadmaps into actionable, short-to-mid-term operational plans (<1 year) across client accounts. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Excellence: </strong>Enforce technical excellence and operational standards across all client deliverables, including causal impact analysis, Bayesian econometrics, predictive propensity modelling, and geospatial segmentation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering & Governance: </strong>Champion rigorous engineering and governance practices across the team: clean code, GitHub project management, reproducibility, data privacy, and ethical AI compliance. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Media Strategy Integration: </strong>Bridge advanced data science capability with client-facing media strategy, directly demonstrating how predictive modelling optimizes planning, budget allocation, and activation. </li> </ul> <p>Programme Delivery & Client Integration </p> <ul> <li><strong>Complex Programme Delivery: </strong>Direct and oversee large, complex client delivery workstreams, ensuring solutions are robust, delivered within scope and timeline, and embedded directly into media activation workflows and WPP Open tools. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Senior Client Partnership: </strong>Act as a trusted technical and strategic partner for senior client stakeholders (Heads of Analytics, Marketing Directors, Performance Leads), interpreting complex data science outputs into clear commercial recommendations. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Integration: </strong>Partner with Agency Planning, Client Leadership, and Data Strategy teams to embed advanced data science solutions (e.g., headroom analysis, automated audience generation) into day-to-day media operations. </li> </ul> <p>People & Operational Management </p> <ul> <li><strong>People Leadership & Development: </strong>Line manage and mentor Associate Directors and Managers, fostering technical growth, high-performance delivery, and structured career progression. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Resource & Capacity Management: </strong>Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and billable utilization across your assigned portfolio, identifying staffing requirements and technical capability gaps. </li> <li><strong>Commercial & Cost Governance: </strong>Partner with the VP to monitor project scopes, manage cloud computing/infrastructure costs, and support accurate revenue forecasting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience </strong></p> <p>Must Have</p> <ul> <li><strong>Marketing, Media Planning & Activation Cycle:</strong> Understanding across the modern media cycle, demonstrating how data science models directly inform insight generation, audience discovery, cross-channel budget optimization, and live activation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Operational & Programme Leadership:</strong> Proven track record managing multi-disciplinary delivery teams and leading managers/specialists within a media agency, management consultancy, or tech-enabled enterprise. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Mastery:</strong> Comprehensive hands-on and architectural understanding of statistical modelling, audience propensity models, inference, regression/econometric frameworks, classification/clustering algorithms, and ML pipelines (Python, SQL, Git). </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Stakeholder Translation:</strong> Demonstrated ability to communicate highly sophisticated mathematical and technical concepts clearly to non-technical executive stakeholders and commercial partners. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery Governance:</strong> Experience managing project scope, milestones, cloud infrastructure expenditure, and cross-functional project teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Typically requires a University Degree (STEM or quantitative field preferred) or equivalent experience, with 10+ years of progressive professional and technical leadership experience. </li> </ul> <p>Nice to Haves </p> <ul> <li>Experience operationalizing data products or custom algorithms within cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure). </li> <li>Familiarity with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, and modern data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbs

great through audience insight, innovation and joined-up thinking.</p> <p>Responsibilities of the role include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading AV planning and buying across clients such as Nationwide, Audible by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Key skills and experience required:</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong AV understanding of measurement across AV channels, alongside current market challenges and solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable handling complex situations, resolving conflict and proposing clear solutions.</li> <li>Effective delegation and strong team management skills.</li> <li>Confident presenter with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to both internal and external description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Data Governance Director. This is a full-time, senior leadership position. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best-in-class service for Amazon in every country across its MGM and CDS business lines.</p> <p>In this role will act as the key operational bridge across internal WPP teams, client leadership, local market contacts, offshore delivery teams, external creative agencies, and third-party partners. By establishing robust workflows, owning platform integrations, and managing data governance compliance, you will ensure campaigns are executed accurately, on time, and in strict alignment with global standards.</p> <p>As a Data Excellence Associate Director, you will be a strategic leader, focused on taxonomy compliance and responsible for championing a customer-centric data excellence strategy, fostering strong relationships with senior stakeholders, and significantly investing in the growth and development of the Data Governance team. You will drive adoption of data quality standards, ensuring OpenDoor's data assets provide maximum business impact for Amazon. </p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p><strong>Operational Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Account Operations:</strong> Partner closely with Activation and Client Leadership to ensure the day-to-day operations of the line of business run seamlessly. Collaborate with relevant eternal stakeholders (e.g. DoubleVerify) to ensure accurate account configuration and tracking integrity, while coordinating team training sessions for newly released features.</li> <li><strong>Process Documentation:</strong> Design, implement, and brief teams on essential operational infrastructure, including live/pre-live status documents, proof of posting (PoP) title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. Overview of the Role You will build the Site Reliability Engineering function at Zego, embedding reliability, observability and operational excellence as core engineering concerns - AI is the primary lever for doing that at scale, not a bolt on. You will be our dedicated SRE, working alongside Systems Engineering and embedded with Product and Engineering across roughly 120 engineers. Teams own their services and their own on-call. You own the framework, the instrumentation and the AI tooling that makes that ownership work. You will make teams good at running what they build: alert quality over alert volume, runbooks an agent can execute rather than prose that describes, and diagnostics good enough that an engineer or an agent reaches resolution without an SRE in the room. You will be the primary advocate for reliability with Product and Engineering, making the case with data rather than assertion, so platform health is prioritised alongside delivery commitments. Key Responsibilities Define and land the reliability standard: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and production readiness criteria that teams apply to their own services, with adoption measured rather than assumed. Encode standards into automation rather than enforcing them by hand. Guardrails in CI, agents that check reliability and observability posture on pull requests, and safe defaults in shared infrastructure so the reliable path is the easy path. Build SRE capability on Zego's AI platform, extending our MCP servers and agents, and making the estate legible to them through machine readable runbooks, structured telemetry and diagnostics an agent can act on. Own observability as a practice, including instrumentation design, signal quality, cardinality and cost. Raise the standard of incident response end-to-end, from detection and triage through to retrospectives that produce change. Put AI to work where it pays off most, stripping toil out of incidents so responders can focus on judgement Measure toil, publish it, and remove it through tooling that others can run without you. What you will need to be successful in the Role We are looking for an engineer who lives SRE and DevOps culture, and treats AI tooling as a default part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. You will engage and empower teams through decisions grounded in data, and you will be as comfortable building with AI as consuming it: extending MCP servers, writing agents, and automating the operational work that would otherwise fill your week. We treat reliability at Zego as a platform capability, so we care more about what you can make repeatable for others than what you can fix yourself. What you’ll bring to the Team Deep SRE experience: SLI and SLO definition, error budget management, and ownership of incident response through to blameless retrospectives. Fluency with AI as an engineering tool rather than a chat window: building agents and automation, working with MCP servers or equivalent, and judgement about where an agent can act and where a human stays in the loop. Strong software engineering in Python, writing tested, maintainable code that other engineers can run and extend. Observability depth with OpenTelemetry and Datadog. AWS at scale, and Kubernetes based platforms managed through Infrastructure as Code. Desirable Istio, Crossplane and ArgoCD. We run all three and will teach the specifics to the right person. Running ML or AI workloads in production, such as model serving or feature pipelines. We do this at Zego and you would help support it. Having been a sole delivery owner somewhere, and knowing what that does and does not mean. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. Equal opportunities 🌈 We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. title: Head of IT & Security
description: If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place. Backed by General Catalyst , the investors behind companies like Stripe and Airbnb, we're building something extraordinary. Our Mission 🌎 At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do. As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale. We do this in two ways: Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes. Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive. And we're already making a difference: $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022. Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database. 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week. Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb , alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam . What We're Building Next 🚀 We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide. By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently. Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems. That's where you come in 🫵 Join us as Head of IT & Security to help our teams support nonprofits with confidence! We’re looking for a practical, technically credible Head of IT & Security to own and improve the systems, services and controls that help Goodstack work effectively and securely. You’ll set the direction, make decisions and deliver changes, leading a small, hands-on team. From improving how colleagues get equipment and access to leading our information-security programme, you’ll connect the details to the wider business and make clear trade-offs around risk, productivity, cost and culture. If you enjoy building a function, developing others and taking improvements from an idea through to a working result, this is an opportunity to shape IT and security in a business helping nonprofits access technology and funding. Working with the VP of Architecture & Infrastructure, you’ll develop the function’s capabilities as Goodstack grows. As Head of IT and Security, your mission will be to: Own IT and security strategy and delivery. Assess our environment, set priorities and deliver improvements alongside your team. Balance security, productivity, cost and culture while meeting customer commitments. Own the roadmap, budget and risk register, making pragmatic decisions, explaining trade-offs and escalating material risks with recommendations. Build IT that scales with Goodstack . Own identity, devices, SaaS, office technology and employee lifecycle processes. Work with People, Finance, Operations and managers to improve the complete employee experience, remove cross-team friction and reduce manual effort without weakening controls. Lead and develop the function . Set direction, coach technical judgement and support complex work while remaining hands-on. Ensure reliable support coverage and protect time for improvements. Anticipate capability gaps and recommend training, tooling, specialist support or hiring. Own security, compliance and assurance. Lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring policies, controls, audits and evidence are maintained year-round. Work with Engineering on application and cloud risks, including XSS, access controls and configuration weaknesses, ensuring remediation is prioritised and verified. Find weaknesses before they cause harm. Challenge assumptions through threat modelling, authorised security testing, incident exercises and recovery tests. Turn findings into preventive improvements, verify their effectiveness and coordinate security incidents when needed. Build a culture of secure working. Make secure behaviour the easiest choice. Understand why shortcuts happen, improve processes and incentives, provide practical training and encourage early reporting. Help colleagues navigate decisions where the right answer isn't obvious. Own vendors and security relationships. Manage suppliers, licences, renewals, service quality, spend and continuity plans. title: Post-Silicon Validation Team Leader
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor and provide technical direction to the Post-Silicon Validation team Plan, design, develop and debug silicon validation and characterisation tests on pre-silicon platforms ahead of first silicon Deploy and debug validation and characterisation tests on first silicon, from initial bring-up through to full functional coverage and silicon characterisation Develop automated test frameworks and regression suites to raise validation throughput Architect and drive continuous improvement of test infrastructure, methodology and processes Analyse test results, isolate failures and root-cause defects across hardware, firmware and software boundaries Enable and support production systems, firmware and software teams through their bring-up Contribute to shared test and validation infrastructure used across the programme Feed findings back to architects and designers to shape future silicon Report programme status and progress to programme management Required Qualifications 8+ years in post-silicon validation in digital ASIC environments Experience in characterisation, failure analysis, test development, statistical analysis Experience leading or technically directing a validation or test engineering team Strong low-level, system software development Excellent working knowledge of digital ASIC design and architecture Ability to work across teams, abstraction layers and programming languages to root-cause deep and complex issues Strong system debug, log analysis and failure isolation skills Ability to drive cross-functional work and communicate clearly with engineering and programme management Preferred Qualifications Driver-level experience with PCIe, memory technologies (LPDDR, DDR, HBM) or peripherals such as I2C, I3C and SPI Knowledge of mixed-signal building blocks — PLLs, high-speed PHYs — and on-chip control and communication protocols Experience with RISC-V CPUs, system IP and associated debug tooling Experience with AMBA protocols Understanding of ML applications and their workloads What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role. Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance. Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. The team is responsible for understanding our prudential regulatory reporting requirements, working on projects and submissions relating to these and collaborating with teams across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Taking ownership of the preparation, analysis and submission of regulatory reporting requirements (e.g. Capital, Liquidity)</li> <li>Ensuring compliance with the applicable regulatory interpretations</li> <li>Assisting the wider team in producing Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)</li> <li>Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete</li> <li>Ensuring high data quality by performing data profiling and investigating data quality issues</li> <li>Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights</li> <li>Partnering with teams internally to help them make informed business decisions and providing input into new product launches</li> <li>Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a good understanding of capital requirements, liquidity reports and regulatory frameworks</li> <li>You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail</li> <li>You have knowledge of coding languages (SQL would be a bonus), although a willingness to learn is just fine </li> <li>You have strong analytical skills, high attention to detail and the ability to meet tight deadlines</li> <li>You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, and implement changes in collaboration with IT and regulatory change teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £56,100 - title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

We’re looking for someone to take those early learnings and build a repeatable, effective sales-led growth function for small and medium-sized businesses.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll help shape which customers we serve, where a human conversation adds the most value, and how Sales works alongside self-serve, Product, Marketing and Operations. You’ll build the team and the playbook—and stay close enough to the work to test, learn and change direction yourself.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to build an AI-native sales function from the start. We want someone who can rethink how the team finds, understands and serves customers: using AI and automation to remove work, improve decisions and give people more time for conversations that matter. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally</strong>. You’ll define our sales strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for its performance and commercial impact. That means reaching and winning the right customers, improving conversion and productivity, and building a sales motion that can grow sustainably.</li> <li><strong>You’ll work closely with RevOps, Product and other teams</strong> to help shape the targets, insights, tools and customer journeys Sales needs, and use them to guide decisions and improve results. </li> <li><strong>Build the SMB sales motion</strong>. Turn what we’re learning from our pilot into a clear strategy for the businesses we can serve best. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and <strong>identify</strong> where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.</li> <li><strong>Make growth count</strong>. Scale a sales motion that brings more high-quality business customers to Monzo, focusing investment where Sales can drive incremental growth and deliver strong returns.</li> <li><strong>Build the team</strong>. Hire, coach and develop high-performing Sales teams and Sales Managers. Set clear expectations, create a culture of learning and accountability, and Put the right team structure, incentives and ways of working in place as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Design the system around the customer</strong>. Work with RevOps, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations on targeting, lead generation, routing, sales process, reporting and forecasting. Spot where the journey breaks down and bring people together to fix it.</li> <li><strong>Make Sales and Product ‘One Team’</strong>. Share what you learn from customers and the sales funnel with Product, and work together on the experience, capabilities and product signals that help the right businesses discover and get value from Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Build an AI-native way of working.</strong> Identify and test opportunities to redesign how the team works—from finding and prioritising prospects to preparing for conversations, following up, coaching and forecasting. Work with specialist teams to put useful tools and workflows in place, measure their impact and embed the ones that work.</li> <li><strong>Use data to guide our approach</strong>. Build a clear view of the funnel, productivity, customer quality and sales economics. Use evidence to guide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.</li> <li><strong>Earn customers’ trust</strong>. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.</li> <li>You’re an experienced sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.</li> <li>You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.</li> <li>You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. You can explain the problem you were solving, what you tested, how you brought people along and what difference it made. </li> <li>You’re a practical change leader. You have experience putting practical changes into action. You can review and improve established ways of working, make progress through ambiguity and help a team adopt new approaches.</li> <li>You know how to get the best from Revenue Operations. You understand the foundations of a healthy sales engine, from lead routing and CRM to forecasting, funnel analysis and sales productivity, and know how to build them with the people who specialise in them.</li> <li>You work well with Product and other teams. You can connect what customers need and what Sales is learning to product and business decisions, and bring people together around a shared outcome.</li> <li>You’re commercially sharp. You understand the economics of growth, use data to challenge assumptions and can balance near-term results with building for the long term. You know when to keep experimenting and when to scale.</li> <li>You might have built in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get there.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.
